blocks.text: Module test A1.1 · Present yourself
Instructions

Week 20 of the calendar, after verification A1-01 → A1-05. Duration: approx. 70 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10 minutes of oral examination with the tutor. Work without notes; Correct only at the end with the solution (Part IV).

Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings (Sections D and E). If you don't exceed: one week on the weakest unit (see table at the bottom of the solutions), then redo sections below 75% with the tutor in the mode of .. Session Test A1.1». Before we start. Section B requires someone to read the script at the beginning of the test solutions, or vocal synthesis (speed 0,8) without reading the text first.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧المَرْكَزُ⁩ . ⁧مَكْتَبِي فِي مَرْكَزِ الشُّرْطَةِ، فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ⁩ . ⁧اِسْمِي هُدَى، وَأَنَا شُرْطِيَّةٌ فِي مِيلَانُو⁩
⁧هُوَ رَجُلٌ طَوِيلٌ⁩ . ⁧زَمِيلِي كَرِيم مُتَرْجِمٌ مِنَ المَغْرِبِ⁩ . ⁧كَبِيرٌ وَحَدِيثٌ، وَهُوَ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الجَامِعَةِ⁩
⁧هِيَ مُهَنْدِسَةٌ مِنْ⁩ . ⁧فِي المَكْتَبِ أَيْضًا زَمِيلَةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ، اِسْمُهَا نَادِيَة⁩ . ⁧وَهَادِئٌ، وَهُوَ ذَكِيٌّ جِدًّا⁩
. ⁧عَلَى مَكْتَبِي حَاسُوبٌ قَدِيمٌ وَصُورَةٌ مِنَ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ . ⁧غُرْفَتِي صَغِيرَةٌ، لٰكِنْ هِيَ هَادِئَةٌ⁩ . ⁧بَيْرُوتَ⁩
. ⁧تِلْكَ الصُّورَةُ جَمِيلَةٌ جِدًّا⁩
Help: ⁧اِسْمُهَا⁩ Your name is yours. ⁧عَلَى⁩ • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. What does he do? Hudā and in what city?
2. Where is the police station and what is it like? (three information)
3. Who is it? Karīm? Describe it.
4. Who is it? Nādiya?
5. How is the room of Hudā And what's on his desk?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the test script B twice. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. At what time of the day is the dialogue taking place? How do you know?
2. Who is it? Samīr for Yūsuf?
3. Where it comes from Samīr?
4. What they say Samīr and Salmā The book?
C · Language (12 points)
One point for an answer. Pronouns and demos. Complete:
1. (speaking to Nādiya) ⁧مُهَنْدِسَةٌ؟⁩ ◌
2. (sign a remote window) ⁧نَافِذَةٌ⁩ ◌ .
3. (please indicate a phone nearby) ⁧؟⁩ ◌ ⁧مَا⁩
Agreement. Write the adjective in the right form:
1. ◌ ⁧مَدِينَةٌ⁩ ( ⁧قَدِيم⁩ ) · 5. ◌ ⁧الشَّارِعُ⁩ ( ⁧ضَيِّق⁩ , syntagma) · 6. ◌ ⁧حَرْبٌ⁩ ( ⁧طَوِيل⁩ )
Phrase or syntagma. Translate into Arabic:
1. The room is quiet. · 8. This quiet room. · 9. There's a pharmacy in the street.
Correction. Each sentence contains an error:
1. . ⁧أَنَا هُوَ طَبِيبٌ⁩ · 11. . ⁧هٰذَا سَيَّارَتِي⁩ · 12. . ⁧البَيْتُ الجَدِيدٌ⁩
D · Written production (8 points)
Write about 60 words, all vocalized, to introduce you to a new study group:
• Greetings and name;
• work and cities;
• your neighborhood or office (what is it, what is it);
• a person you know (work, origin, adjective);
• an object you have with you, with a demonstration;
• leave.
Evaluation (heading of the Plan, section) 6.3): Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4. Each missing item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10 minutes.
1. Free presentation of one minute without reading (the same contents as section D).
2. Three questions from the tutor about what you said; answer with full sentences.
3. The tutor shows you four objects or photos: ask what is it?

Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. He pronounces it the tutor's rating. Without tutor, record the test and evaluate Accuracy and Fluidity with transcription; The Pronunciation score remains pending until a native speaker listens to the recording, and the test is considered to have passed until then.
